text:
Fixed the `memoize` cache leakage bug.

Root cause: `memoize` used a mutable default argument (`cache={}`), causing all memoized functions without an explicit cache to share the same dictionary.

Changed it to initialize a fresh cache per decorated function when no cache is provided. All targeted tests pass.

final_text:
Fixed the `memoize` cache leakage bug.

Root cause: `memoize` used a mutable default argument (`cache={}`), causing all memoized functions without an explicit cache to share the same dictionary.

Changed it to initialize a fresh cache per decorated function when no cache is provided. All targeted tests pass.
